tool.name: official @qoder-ai/qodercli npm compatibility CLI
tool.distribution: Official npm compatibility CLI;not desktop IDE

runtime.projects: Five actual generated and moved presets,each mounted readonly
runtime.configuration: A fresh distinct user configuration for each project;automatic update disabled only in these owned test configurations

method: Execute the official CLI local discovery command in each generated project,then compare enabled names,descriptions and locations with its native entry frontmatter and compare complete derived bytes with the canonical source via the formal adapter. Directory existence alone is not treated as native discovery.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

skills.name: omni-change
skills.description: Implement or review Omni-Stack changes using the project's fact documents, module catalog, controlled Docker verification, and delivery boundaries. Use for changes in this repository or generated Omni-Stack projects.
